confirm.createNote: It is added to the catalogue right away.
confirm.saveNote: The change applies everywhere it is used.
confirm.deleteUsed_one: It is used by {{count}} service. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteUsed_other: It is used by {{count}} services. This cannot be undone.

order.note: The customer's order moves to the next step.
order.cancelNote: A cancelled order cannot be reopened.

user.banNote: They will not be able to sign in.

stock.note: This is written to the stock history and cannot be edited afterwards.

deleteNoteFor.service: The service leaves the catalogue, with its recipe and its links to variant and modifier groups. Past orders keep what they sold. This cannot be undone.
deleteNoteFor.outlet: The outlet is deleted with its opening hours. This cannot be undone. An outlet that has staff, orders or stock cannot be deleted; switch it off instead.
deleteNoteFor.banner: The banner is deleted for good and disappears from the app. This cannot be undone. To hide it for a while, switch it off instead.
deleteNoteFor.voucher: The voucher is deleted for good and disappears from the app. This cannot be undone. A voucher that customers already hold cannot be deleted; switch it off instead.

confirm.reorder: Save the new order of {{count}} banners?
confirm.reorderNote: The customer app's carousel follows this order right away.
confirm.sendVoucherNote: It goes straight into their wallets. It cannot be taken back from them; you can switch the voucher off to stop it being used.
